---
title: "Add a new client"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-03 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Put a new owner and their dog on file, so the dog can be checked in, booked
and groomed.

## Applies to

Every groomer, when an owner and dog come to the shop for the first time.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile. See [GRM-01 Sign in to your
  profile](signing-in.qmd).
- Search for the dog first, to make sure it is not already on file. See
  [GRM-02 Check in a dog](checking-in-a-dog.qmd).
- If the owner already has another dog on file, follow [GRM-04 Add another
  dog for an owner](another-dog.qmd) instead.

## Procedure

### Enter the owner and the dog

1. Click **+ New client** on the left side of the Check-in screen, above the
   list of dogs. The **New client** form opens on the right.

   If you searched for a name that is not on file, you can click **Add as a
   new client** under **No dog or owner by that name.** instead. The form
   opens with the name you typed already filled in.

   ![The New client form](/screenshots/groomer/new-client.png)

2. In the **Owner** box, click **First name** and type the owner's first
   name.
3. Click **Last name** and type the owner's last name.
4. Click **Phone** and type the owner's phone number, or click **Email** and
   type the owner's email address. Enter at least one, so the shop can reach
   the owner.
5. In the **Dog** box, click **Name** and type the dog's name.
6. Click **Breed** and choose the dog's breed from the list. You can type
   the first letters to shorten the list. If nobody knows the breed, leave it
   blank.

   If the breed is a mix, tick **Mixed breed**. Under **Mixed with**, click
   **Unknown**, or click **A breed I can name** and choose the second breed
   in **Other breed**.

7. Under **Coat**, click the dog's coat type. The coat is required. If you
   chose a breed, the system has already selected that breed's usual coat;
   click a different one if this dog's coat is different.
8. Under **Sex**, click **Female**, **Male** or **Not sure**.
9. If the owner knows the dog's birthday, click **Birthday** and enter it. A
   puppy needs a birthday, so that it is not asked for vaccines it is too
   young for.
10. Click **Save and add paperwork**. The owner and dog are saved, and the
    **Paperwork for** form opens with the dog's name.

### Add the dog's paperwork

11. If the owner brought no paperwork, click **No paperwork today**. The
    dog's card opens. You are finished.

12. If the owner brought vaccination records, follow [GRM-06 Add vaccine
    paperwork](paperwork.qmd) from step 2. At the end, the last button reads
    **Finish · open** the dog's card, instead of **Done checking** or
    **Done**. Click it. The dog's card opens.

## Result

The new dog appears in the list on the Check-in screen, and its card is open
on the right.

## If something goes wrong

### "…" isn't on the breed list.

The breed typed is not one the shop knows. If one of the names after **Did
you mean** is right, click it. If the breed is real but missing from the
list, click **No, it's one the list doesn't have**. It is added to the
list.

### Choose the coat to save.

**Save and add paperwork** cannot be clicked until a coat is chosen. Click
one of the buttons under **Coat**.
